messages:
indra: Quick brain dump — we need to decide where policy evaluation (routing + quotas) should live for internal APIs. proto-first gRPC between services but gateway does public REST. Two options: central policy at gateway (fast fail) vs distributed policy at services (authoritative). Thoughts?

maya: +1 to proto-first for internal traffic. gateway pre-checks reduce wasted work, but gateway-only quotas make it hard to enforce policies that depend on model selection or runtime signals computed inside the service.

sam: hybrid sounds pragmatic — cheap pre-check at gateway (rate limit, auth) + authoritative accounting/validation at service. gateway issues a precheck token so service can verify and consume. keeps latency low for rejects.

alex: telemetry caveat — if we split checks we must mark traces with precheck/consume spans. console dashboards should be able to show prechecks vs actual consumes so we can detect gaps.

liz-product: UX ask: rollout page needs to show canary vs baseline for latency + token-cost delta + per-minute quota consumption. also the fallback/deny rate (so PMs can see impact).

indra: implementation sketch: gateway does quick policy eval (auth, soft quota) and signs a short-lived precheck token included in metadata for the internal gRPC call. service validates token then performs authoritative accounting. this lets gateway short-circuit most bad requests.

maya: note on perf: gRPC metadata is fine, but Envoy header rewrite & TLS termination at scale can add some tail latency. prefer passing signed metadata through without heavy Envoy lua transforms where possible.

sam: security: precheck token must be HMAC-signed with zone key + ttl. code snippet for header format:```
x-rd-routing: tenant=acme;priority=low
x-rd-precheck: id=abc123;sig=sha256:...;exp=1700000000
```

alex: console telemetry: compute "effective quota gap" = prechecks - consumes per route; alert when gap > 1% for 5m. also surface sample traces where precheck succeeded but consume failed with reason.

deploy-bot: canary started for gateway-route routing-v2 (id: rv2) at 2024-11-03T15:02:00Z :rocket:

indra: proposed decision (draft): 1) proto-first internal RPCs, 2) gateway performs prechecks + issues signed precheck tokens, 3) services validate tokens and do authoritative accounting, 4) console exposes precheck vs consume metrics + rollout health (latency/cost/fallback), 5) RFC incoming with config shape and header spec.

maya: sg

sam: lgtm, please include exp and key-rotation notes in RFC

liz-product: thanks — will add the metrics/column asks for the rollout page

indra: I'll draft RFC and ping infra for HSM/HMAC key plan. tagging @maya and @sam for review.
